""on [date] at about 1355 hours, i, cpl. p. krekel #286, was requested to investigate a crash scene, in which a pedestrian was struck by a vehicle. i arrived on scene, and made contact with the driver, christina jones, who stated she was at the stop light at the intersection [roadway], waiting for her northbound light to turn green. she stated it did, so she proceeded through the intersection, and as she was driving by the 7-11, the pedestrian, menyon samuels, walked in front of her vehicle, and she slammed on the brakes when she noticed samuels, but still struck her. she stated she was only doing about 20 mph when she struck the samuels. i received a phone call from the transporting med unit, who stated samuels was alert and was talking [medical facility]. they said she had a broken arm, and some possible internal injuries [medical facility], and get a status of her condition, [medical facility] staff advised samuels was stable. i went to valero and reviewed cctv video, which showed the crash. samuels is walking west from the 7-11 parking lot, about 50-75 feet north of the crosswalk, in the northbound lanes of travel. it appears that samuels was almost struck by other vehicles as she wasn't paying attention to oncoming cars, or had no care to do so. as samuels [roadway], the cadillac suv driven by jones enters in to the frame, and appears to only be traveling at about 30 mph. it appears to be accelerating, but not a heavy acceleration, as the front end is only slightly higher than the back end. the front end dips sharply however, but samuels is still struck as she crosses in front of the cadillac. she rolls on to the hood, then rolls off and rolls on the ground for a total distance of about 10 ft from where the impact occurred. based on all circumstances, i will not be filing any criminal charges on this [case id] to the accident. samuels was a pedestrian in the roadway, [roadway] in the area where a crosswalk is provided.""[person] arrested on an outstanding warrant and instandered on the citation for no driver's license. the vehicle was towed by j&n wrecker. supplement: after review body camera, it was determined the driver did not exhibit driver inattention before or during the crash. the reporting officer believes its was a mistake and may have confused it for another accident he work not long after this one.
